name: eufy Omni E25
summary: An all-in-one robot vacuum and roller mop whose dock empties the bin and washes and dries the mop. Independent tests put it near the top for pet hair, tangle resistance and obstacle avoidance, but the dock is the biggest in this guide and the robot is 4.4 in tall.
idealFor: Pet owners who can spare floor space for a dock
Apartments with a mix of carpet and hard floors
pros: Dock empties the bin, washes and dries the roller mop
93% pet hair pickup and 0% hair wrap in Vacuum Wars tests
Avoided 21 of 24 obstacles in Vacuum Wars tests
cons: Biggest dock here: 14.6 × 19.1 in and 17.3 in tall
4.4 in tall, so it won't fit under many low sofas
Initial mapping took several attempts in TechRadar's test

specs.Dock: Auto-empty, mop wash and dry, 3 L bag
specs.Mopping: Self-cleaning roller mop, lifts on carpet

trust.summary: Three independent hands-on reviews agree it vacuums and mops well, with strong pet-hair results. eufy publishes measurable claims, a 12-month warranty with a claim process and a US address, but its US product page lists no dimensions or weight. Safety scores 8/20: no CPSC recalls for eufy robot vacuums (Anker's recalls were power banks, speakers and coolers), but we could not verify a UL/ETL listing or FCC ID.

sources.title: TechRadar: eufy E25 Omni review
sources.note: Tim Gee, Dec 2025, used over two floors. Robot 4.4 in tall, dock 14.6 × 19.1 × 17.3 in; excellent max-mode mopping, strong obstacle avoidance; mapping needed several attempts
